itemUnidentifiable.detail: before item 0 is unidentifiable: guid/id, link, and title are all absent or empty; empty title is not an identity, so matching across feeds is unreliable

differenceInDeliveredOutput: Briefs item add/remove/title-link-updated corrections and dedup-key counts over supplied XML. Does not poll feeds, push alerts, or assert content authenticity.

freeBaseline.description: Diff supplied local artifacts with maintained offline parsers (yaml / csv-parse / fast-xml-parser). No URL fetch, no LLM, no notifications, no marketplace listing.
